   422	def analyse(n, edges, paths, proofs, delivered):
   423	    labels = [e["label"] for e in edges]
   424	    classes = {}
   425	    for path in paths:
   426	        mask = 0
   427	        sig = []
   428	        for eid in path:
   429	            mask |= 1 << eid
   430	            sig.append(labels[eid])
   431	        sig = tuple(sig)
   432	        bucket = classes.get(sig)
   433	        if bucket is None:
   434	            classes[sig] = [(path, mask)]
   435	        else:
   436	            bucket.append((path, mask))
   437	
   438	    order = sorted(classes)
   439	    index = {sig: i for i, sig in enumerate(order)}
   440	    evidence = [set() for _ in order]
   441	
   442	    for rid in delivered:
   443	        proof = proofs[rid]
   444	        if proof is None:
   445	            continue
   446	        pmask = 0
   447	        for eid in proof:
   448	            pmask |= 1 << eid
   449	        for sig, bucket in classes.items():
   450	            for _path, pm in bucket:
   451	                if pm & pmask == pm:
   452	                    evidence[index[sig]].add(rid)
   453	                    break
   454	
   455	    classes_out = []
   456	    observed_classes = 0
   457	    unique_observed = 0
   458	    ambiguous_observed = 0
   459	    upper = 0
   460	    for sig in order:
   461	        bucket = classes[sig]
   462	        k = len(bucket)
   463	        rounds_seen = sorted(evidence[index[sig]])
   464	        if rounds_seen:
   465	            observed_classes += 1
   466	            upper += k
   467	            if k == 1:
   468	                unique_observed += 1
   469	                state = "unique"
   470	            else:
   471	                ambiguous_observed += 1
   472	                state = "ambiguous"
   473	        else:
   474	            state = "unobserved"
   475	        if k == 1:
   476	            witnesses = [list(bucket[0][0])]
   477	        else:
   478	            witnesses = [list(bucket[0][0]), list(bucket[1][0])]
   479	        classes_out.append({
   480	            "signature": list(sig),
   481	            "candidate_count": k,
   482	            "evidence_rounds": rounds_seen,
   483	            "state": state,
   484	            "candidate_witnesses": witnesses,
   485	        })
   486	
   487	    observable = len(order)
   488	    if observable == 0:
   489	        status = "no-routes"
   490	    elif observed_classes == 0:
   491	        status = "no-evidence"
   492	    elif observed_classes == observable:
   493	        status = "complete"
   494	    else:
   495	        status = "partial"
   496	
   497	    summary = {
   498	        "topology_paths": len(paths),
   499	        "observable_classes": observable,
   500	        "observed_classes": observed_classes,
   501	        "unique_observed_classes": unique_observed,
   502	        "ambiguous_observed_classes": ambiguous_observed,
   503	        "path_evidence_lower": observed_classes,
   504	        "path_evidence_upper": upper,
   505	        "coverage_status": status,
   506	    }
   507	    return classes_out, summary

   510	def solve(obj):
   511	    n = obj["n"]
   512	    edges = obj["edges"]
   513	    rounds = obj["rounds"]
   514	    paths = enumerate_paths(n, edges)
   515	    rounds_out, metrics, proofs, delivered_flags = simulate(n, obj["capacity"],
   516	                                                            edges, rounds)
   517	    delivered = [rid for rid, t in enumerate(delivered_flags) if t is not None]
   518	    classes_out, summary = analyse(n, edges, paths, proofs, delivered)

   520	            "classes": classes_out, "summary": summary}
